    """Generate Hilbert curve coordinates for given order and canvas size."""
    points = []
    def rotate(x, y, rx, ry):
        if ry == 0:

                y = size - 1 - y

Tapering fin/ring widths from center outward matches flux density.

proposal.title: Branching spiral arms with width tapering
proposal.rationale: Spiral_tapered_fin (72.56C) and multi_arm_spiral (72.56C) show spirals work well. Branching increases fin count with radius to match growing circumference, maintaining ~constant fin spacing. Each branch inherits parent width then tapers. This better utilizes material budget at large radii where single spirals leave gaps.

proposal.title: Radial near chip transitioning to Cartesian grid
proposal.rationale: Radial designs excel near chip (high flux density) but leave corner regions underutilized (field data shows material concentrated at 12-18mm radius). Cartesian grid fills corners efficiently. A transition zone with 45-degree diagonal fins bridges the two. Hierarchical_radial_quad (72.56C) hints at this but used quadtree; explicit radial-to-Cartesian may improve corner convection.
